messages:
frank: Heads-up: tokenizer normalization changed in the new model bundle. Need a 2-line release blurb, a tiny migration snippet for JS and Python, and a short known-issue note about older prompt templates that rely on legacy token counts. Target: morning deploy.
yasmin: Putting up a draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1720 - added a blurb under /releases/tokenizer-normalization plus examples. PTAL.
otto: Small compatibility note: normalized whitespace and unicode composition mean char->token mapping shifts; some rate-limit heuristics and prompt-slicing may undercount. Added a short repro in the PR.
otto: Example old vs new tokenization (conceptual):
```
# old: "cafe\u0301" -> tokens: ["cafe","\u0301"]  (counts 2)
# new: "cafe\u0301" -> tokens: ["café"]  (counts 1)
```
yasmin: Can we recommend SDK helpers to re-tokenize/estimate length? Suggest SDK >=0.10.5 which exposes .token_count(text) and a one-line snippet.
frank: Yes, keep it tiny. Also add a troubleshooting note: customers using static prompt-splitters may need to regen slices or use the SDK helper to avoid off-by-one prompts.
yasmin: Added JS and Python migration snippets to the PR: 
```javascript
// SDK >=0.10.5
const count = client.tokens.count("café\n"); // returns 1
```
```python
# SDK >=0.10.5
count = client.tokens.count("café\n")  # returns 1
```
sdk-bot: Note: compatibility shim available in SDK 0.10.5 that maps legacy estimates for a transition window.
frank: Please add a one-line known-issue pill: "Legacy prompt templates that assume prior token counts may exceed new limits; use client.tokens.count() or update templates." Keep wording short.
otto: Also add a tiny log snippet showing a common support report so triage can grep: 
```
User report: "sudden prompt truncation after update" -> token_count_old=256 token_count_new=261
```
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1720--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/tokenizer-normalization). Lint and link-check passed.
frank: Can reviewers react with :shipit: or leave comments? Plan to merge after CI and cut the site by 07:30.
yasmin: :shipit: small wording tweak pushed to PR (clarified "normalization").
otto: :shipit: added an extra test note in PR comments about prompt templates in sample-apps.
sdk-bot: CI green. Auto-redirects and anchors verified.
frank: Merged. I'll add the release bullet to release-notes and ping product. Thanks! Closing thread. :wave:
